newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice ends firm as U.S. harvest winds down.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice ends firm as U.S. harvest winds down.

text.p: CBOT rice futures ended firm on diminished threat of hedge selling pressure as the U.S. rice harvest slows down, traders said.
"The U.S. rice harvest was 84 percent complete so it's certainly winding down but there continue to be reports of good yields," a trader said.

Traders said gains in rice futures were trimmed by an erosion of cash values in Asian markets with the benchmark Thai price now thought down to $305.00 per tonne. Last week the Thai price was posted at roughly $318.00 per tonne, a trader said.
Rice futures volume was estimated at 350 contracts, up from 181 Monday.
Rice futures closed two to three cents per cwt higher, with November up two at $9.80.
